status: DIGEST RECORD — the digests are final and re-derivable; the two role fields are PLACEHOLDERS and the record is NOT a valid freeze until the reviewer fills them and publishes it

roles.caseAuthor: UNNAMED — the case author, to be filled by the reviewer
roles.freezingReviewer: UNNAMED — the freezing reviewer, to be filled by the reviewer
roles.statement: the case author and the freezing reviewer are different people, and neither wrote a solver

fields.branchShaMeaning: the exact commit the freeze is taken on - the repository's HEAD, resolved from .git/HEAD and that branch's ref (loose or packed). The protocol's baseline is b7bd1be4, and a freeze normally records its own SHA, which is NOT the baseline
fields.dataset.digestScope: the UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON `cases` array + one line feed

domainA.groundingRule: the cited proposition is byte-identical to a gold proposition AND the cited claim id is the production id of that source in the workspace under test
